review.notes: All 16 PDF pages word-compared with the OCR markdown; balanced structure, 5 figure image embeds present. Only drops found were two footnote bodies whose superscript markers survive inline (Mistral Small Creative on p.7; ElevenLabs v3 emotion tags on p.9); both URLs verified on 300 dpi renders. Chart data labels on p.11 (Figure 4) and architecture-diagram tokens on p.3 are figure-internal and correctly absent from the markdown; Table 7 and Table 8 values match print. The arXiv side stamp on p.1 and hyphenation splits (intelligi-bility, Au-diolm) are page furniture/rendering artifacts, not defects.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.7 footnote line prints "1https://docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-small-creative-25-12" in monospace (visually verified at 300 dpi). The OCR kept the inline marker in "Mistral Small Creative $^{1}$" but dropped the footnote body; restores it after the carrying paragraph, following the numbered-footnote format used by prior cleanups (e.g. cohere:north-small-translate).

Rendered physical p.9 footnote prints "2https://elevenlabs.io/blog/eleven-v3-audio-tags-expressing-emotional-context-in-speech" wrapped over two lines with no hyphen (visually verified at 300 dpi). The OCR kept "enclosed in brackets $^{2}$" but dropped the footnote body.
